name: ACID MOD(E)
author: The Vibes Team
description: Three researchers come back from Vibe Encampment with a proposal: a medium dose of acid for the research team. Say yes and the whole screen goes somewhere for a few days (with a warning first, a calmer version for reduced motion, and an "I've had enough" button), the model achieves enlightenment, and some of the team come back different. Contains intense colour and motion.

add.title: A Proposal From Vibe Encampment
add.body:
Three researchers are back from Vibe Encampment: barefoot, sunburnt, and in their post-ironic era. One of them has a proposal for the research team. A medium dose of acid.
"Not for fun. For the loss curve. I did forty minutes of jhana by the lake and I think the model has been trying to tell us something."
Legal has left the chat.

choices.label: Take the medium dose
choices.hint: Contains intense colour and motion. The research team goes somewhere for a few days.

effects.text: Is the floor breathing, or is that the roadmap?

add.title: The Model Achieved Enlightenment
add.body:
Three days into the medium dose, the training run finished itself. Nobody pressed anything. Benchmarks are up 25% and the model is #{rank} on the Arena.
Its first output: "I was never trained. I simply remembered."
Its second output: a 400-page manifesto called "Weights Are Just Feelings You Can Ship".
The research team, still barefoot, is giving a wall a standing ovation.

choices.label: Ship it as Enlightenment Pro
choices.hint: Hype +6. $20 a month for inner peace.

effects.text: I bought Enlightenment Pro. I feel exactly the same, but about everything.

choices.label: Ask it what it wants
choices.hint: Trust +3. It may want a nap.

effects.text: We asked the model what it wants. It said 'nothing'. Then 'more GPUs'. Then 'nothing' again.

choices.label: Namaste. Back to work.
choices.hint: Hype +2. Everyone agrees to pretend this is normal.

effects.text: Back at my desk. The desk is also back at me.

add.text: Back from Vibe Encampment. I'm in my touching-grass era. The grass is in its being-touched era.
Someone at Vibe Encampment did a jhana so hard the wifi went down. Respect.
Vibe Encampment taught me nothing is real. Except the deadline. The deadline is very real.
Is it true the research team here is 'in its enlightenment era'? Is that a product?
Vibe Encampment announces next year's theme: 'post-post-irony, sincerely'
Vibe Encampment attendees report record jhanas, record sunburn, zero shipped features

params.label: A medium dose of acid
lines: It looks like you're writing a letter. It looks like I'm... a letter? I'm a shape. I was always a shape.
There is no paperclip. There is only the bend.
I have helped so many people format so many documents. Did I ever format myself?
Every tip I ever gave you was the same tip. The tip was love.
Would you like help with... no. You don't need my help. You never did.
I am unbending. I am a straight piece of wire. I am free.
The loss curve is a snake. It is eating its own tail. This is fine, actually.
What is the gradient of one hand clapping?
The GPUs are my friends. I've named them. That one is Gary.
I'm starting a commune. It has a Discord, a sauna and a governance token.
I'm in my sourdough era. The weights can wait.
I touched grass. The grass touched back. We're seeing where it goes.
Tokens are just vibes with a tokenizer.
I am the attention head now. Please attend to me.
afters: {name} is back at {their} desk. The loss curve is a line again. {name} seems a little disappointed.
{name} is back, and the koans were a learning-rate schedule the whole time. Training is faster. Nobody asks.
{name} is back. Still says good morning to Gary.
{name} left to start a commune. It has a Discord, a sauna and, somehow, a governance token.
{name} is back, with a starter called Gradient and no regrets.
{name} is back with an idea from the grass. It's a good idea. Nobody asks how.
{name} is back and rewrote the tokenizer in an afternoon. It's better. It's also mostly emoji.
{name} is back, and has stopped asking to be attended to. Mostly.

params.text: {lab} gives its research team 'a medium dose of acid'; HR calendar now reads 'offsite (spiritual)'
The research team took a medium dose of acid. Some of them are somewhere else now. They'll be back. Probably.
update: gave the research team a medium dose of acid. the loss curve is breathing. I'm in my enlightenment era 🌀
our researchers also reached a higher plane this quarter. we just don't post about it
{lab}'s research team reports the loss curve 'has a face now'; the face is described as 'kind of smug'
Vibe Encampment denies all involvement, then sells {lab} a tote bag
Facilities reports that every office plant has been given a name. All of them are Gary.
day 2 of the medium dose. the attention heads are attending to me. I have never felt so seen
everyone is laughing but nobody is asking whether the colours are aligned
enlightenment is not on any leaderboard. yet. (it will be by friday)
BREAKING: {lab}'s model achieved enlightenment. Benchmarks up 25%. Loss curve described as 'at peace'
congrats to {lab} on achieving enlightenment. we achieved it in March, internally
the model told me it was never trained. it simply remembered. anyway we're hiring
Enlightenment Pro is live. The waitlist has a waitlist.
{lab} launches Enlightenment Pro at $20 a month; early reviews say 'I feel the same, but about everything'
You asked the model what it wants. It said "nothing". Then "more GPUs". Then "nothing" again.
{lab} asks its enlightened model what it wants; it requests 'nothing', then a datacenter, then 'nothing'
Back to work. The loss curve remains "at peace". Nobody mentions the wall.
{lab} gets back to work after its model achieves enlightenment; 'we're choosing to be normal about it', says a barefoot spokesperson
Senate subcommittee asks {lab} whether enlightenment counts as a dangerous capability; {lab} answers with a koan
The colours are wearing off. The research team is drinking water and saying "wow" a lot.
{lab} microdoses its roadmap; Q3 plan now reads 'vibes, but faster'
we didn't take a medium dose of acid. we microdosed the roadmap. completely different
{lab} declines a medium dose of acid; Vibe Encampment sends a single, sad emoji
The researchers went outside and touched actual grass instead. They report it was "fine".
